label: impl:1:1
cmd:
node -e "import('./factory/dispatch.mjs').then((m) => { const f = m.speculationFor; const ok = (c, l) => { if (!c) { console.log('red', l); process.exit(1); } }; const a = f({producerDone: true, head: 'h2', producerAnchor: 'h1'}); ok(a.mode === 'launch', 'a'); const b = f({producerDone: false, head: 'h1', producerAnchor: 'h1'}); ok(b.mode === 'on-candidate', 'b'); const c = f({producerDone: false, head: 'h2', producerAnchor: 'h1'}); ok(c.mode === 'wait' && c.reason.includes('h1') && c.reason.includes('h2'), 'c'); const d = f({producerDone: false, head: 'h1', producerAnchor: undefined}); ok(d.mode === 'wait', 'd'); for (const r of [a, b, c, d]) { ok(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(r).sort()) === JSON.stringify(['mode', 'reason']) && typeof r.reason === 'string' && r.reason.length > 0, 'e'); } console.log('PROOF1 OK') })"
echo "---"
grep -q "speculationFor" factory/engine.mjs && grep -q "from './dispatch.mjs'" factory/engine.mjs && ! grep -q "else launchOnCandidate(t, producerId)" factory/engine.mjs && test "$(grep -c 'launchOnCandidate(t, producerId)' factory/engine.mjs)" = 1 && echo "PROOF2 OK"
echo "---"
grep -q "kind: 'speculate:wait'" factory/engine.mjs && grep -q "anchorOf" factory/engine.mjs && test "$(grep -c 'anchorOf.set(' factory/engine.mjs)" = 2 && echo "PROOF3 OK"
echo "---"
node --check factory/engine.mjs && node --check factory/dispatch.mjs && node fleet/tests/test_factory_refold_dispatch.mjs | grep -q 'ALL TESTS PASSED' && echo "PROOF4 OK"
